value.text: Plan of the Milan Cathedral. Uppercase letters from A to E indicate the buttresses, lowercase letters from a to e indicate the portals. Roman numerals I to XXXIX indicate the windows, Arabic numerals 1 to 41 indicate the buttresses, statues are marked with lowercase letters. (I) Stained glass with stories of St. John the Evangelist, (V) Stained glass with stories of the New Testament, (9) Funerary monument of Gian Giacomo Medici, (18) Portal of the southern sacristy, (20) Statue of Martin V by Jacopino da Tradate, (25) Portal by Giacomo da Campione, (XXV) Stained glass with stories of St. John of Damascus, (30) Chapel of Madonna dell'Albero, (31) Trivulzio Candelabrum.
